sealed_record.thesis: The single highest-conviction position of the most-cited author in this corpus is not the token everyone quotes him on. On 2026-09-28 kiototrades named CARDS - the subject of his very first research article, 8 months ago - as literally his favourite token and said he has been accumulating continuously ever since and will hold it for years if needed, while in the same breath flagging a possible Coinbase partnership as the chop-breaker. The market is pricing his AI/SI/BUN calls, which are all crowded and blocklisted here, and is pricing nothing for the name he actually refuses to sell. The asymmetry is that a real CEX listing or partnership on a token nobody is front-running is a step-function repricing, and the downside is a slow bleed in an asset the largest informed holder is still buying.

outcome.thesis_note: DITUTUP -39.9%. Ditutup dalam unwind seluruh buku call. Long kripto ikut turun bersama pasar (BTC ~$64,8 ribu).
